ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag, description and social tags (og:title, og:image) in index.html
ideas.why: Accurate (no viewport or og tags exist), but standard head hygiene with modest effect on being found.

ideas.idea: Give each mug its own page/route (/catalogue/:id) with links
ideas.why: The catalogue renders only names as plain paragraphs with no per-item URLs, so individual mugs can't be linked or indexed.

ideas.idea: Show price, material and size per mug, with Product structured data
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx outputs only m.name, so adding product details and Product JSON-LD gives machines real information.

ideas.idea: Add a shipping/contact/about page and link it from navigation
ideas.why: Home claims Bristol and worldwide shipping but no page supports it and the nav has only two items.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite structured data with the shop name
ideas.why: No JSON-LD exists so it's accurate, but it applies to nearly any site and has small effect.

ideas.idea: Declare the site's domain once and use it for canonical tags and sitemap
ideas.why: No domain or canonical exists in the repo, and canonicals and sitemap URLs need an absolute origin.

ideas.idea: Add a footer or fuller navigation with onward links from the home page to mug pages
ideas.why: Home.jsx has no links to the catalogue or products; only the nav links, so internal linking is thin.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> to the sitemap once it exists
ideas.why: Accurate but minor, and depends on a sitemap that doesn't exist yet.

ideas.idea: Add width and height to the hero image
ideas.why: The img lacks dimensions, but this mainly affects layout shift and has little discoverability effect.

ideas.idea: Use per-page titles/meta via a head helper such as react-helmet or React 19 <title> tags
ideas.why: Both routes share one static title and React 19 is in use, so per-route titles are a concrete fix.

ideas.idea: Prerender or server-render the catalogue data fetched from /api/mugs
ideas.why: The catalogue list is fetched client-side in useEffect, so even prerendered shells would lack the mug names unless data is included at build or server time.
